name: Sales-Sync: Ambil & Kirim Log Penjualan (Langsung API)

parameters.query: SELECT token, status, expires_at FROM api_tokens a JOIN platforms p ON p.platform_id = a.platform_id WHERE p.name = 'shopeefood' LIMIT 1;
SELECT token, status, expires_at FROM api_tokens a JOIN platforms p ON p.platform_id = a.platform_id WHERE p.name = 'grabfood' LIMIT 1;
SELECT token, status, expires_at FROM api_tokens a JOIN platforms p ON p.platform_id = a.platform_id WHERE p.name = 'gofood' LIMIT 1;
SELECT token FROM api_tokens t JOIN platforms p ON p.platform_id = t.platform_id WHERE p.name = 'majoo' AND t.status = 'valid' LIMIT 1;

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Import log-penjualan (langsung API): ' + $json.errors.length + ' baris CSV gagal disimpan. Detail: ' + JSON.stringify($json.errors) }}
